title: Mahanirvana
author: Trishna Basak
text:
Chunda! Chunda! Bury now this pork
Deep into the earth,
There`s none in the world who can
Absorb such meat,
Oh! Ananda! What a bed you`ve made
Under the cover of the Saal
Saal is my favourite tree-
Saal, White Elephant, The Moon atop the elephant-head

In a lion`s poise let me recline on this bed
And recall
The Three dishes I`ve ever relished-
The pork that Chunda brought
Ananda! Let everybody know
The delight that Chunda with his pork had brought
And then the rice porridge that Sujata cooked
Ananda! Come hither
My voice has grown so feeble
It cant be heard from far
The third, the third Yashodhara gave
Or was it really the first!
Ananda! Keep a secret, please
You, with only you I confide
The divine elixir was what Yashodhara made me draw
From the golden orbs of her breasts

Oh!Ananda! Darkness descends in the woods
Kindle yourself,
Be the lamp that`ll show you light.
(Translated by Bappaditya Roy Biswas)
